title: fix(service-messaging): a role: audience resolves in the emitting organization only
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`role:` 受众只在发出通知的组织内解析——生产者传入的组织,否则取事件行上存储的组织;两者皆无时 `role:` 解析为 0 个收件人并告警,与 `org:members` 一致。
- 为什么改:通知的收件人范围应与该通知所属组织一致,与其投递行、收件箱行和回执行已携带的组织保持同一个。
- 风险与回滚:未传组织、事件行上也没有组织的 `role:` 通知将不再送达任何人(会打印一条告警,写明补救办法);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-messaging/src/recipient-resolver.ts` 的 `resolveRole`;`messaging-service.ts` 第 3 步传入的组织;两个测试文件末尾新增的 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/recipient-resolver.test.ts src/messaging-service.test.ts`,预期 117/117 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: **a `role:NAME` audience resolves in the emitting organization — the organization the producer passed, else the one stored on the notification's own event row — and names the holders of that role in that organization and in no other. With no emitting organization, `role:` names nobody: 0 recipients, a warning that names the remedy, and no membership read. Every other selector is unchanged: `org:members` still resolves with the producer's organization, and nobody when it names none.**

- `recipient-resolver.ts` (`resolveRole`): the organization is required; without one the selector resolves to 0 recipients with a warning, and the membership read always carries the organization. TSDoc on `ResolveContext.organizationId` and the class summary say the same.
- `messaging-service.ts` (`emit`, step 3): `resolveAudience` gives `role:` specs the `owned` organization (the producer's, else the stored event row's) and every other spec the producer's organization alone. When the two agree it is the single resolver call it was before. `recipient-resolver.ts` adds the module-level `isRoleAudience` (not re-exported from the package index), which the resolver also uses, so both read a spec the same way.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-zero-delivery-visibility.integration.test.ts`: the same rule's consumer pin. Its schedule CONTROL now carries the recipients' organization (still MANAGERS.length deliveries), a new pin asserts a tick with no organization reaches 0 recipients, and the header states the rule.
- One `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/service-messaging`.

No exported type, signature or accepted value changes; `Audience` and `EmitInput` are byte-identical. The old TSDoc already described `role:` as tenant-scoped, so the declarations are `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`; the seat re-judges if it reads this otherwise.

## Tests

Named for the rule, with controls on the unchanged paths:

- `recipient-resolver.test.ts`, describe "role: names the holders of that role in the emitting organization, and nobody without one": holders in the emitting organization only (control); no organization (absent or empty): 0 recipients, a warning, zero reads; the rest of an audience still resolves when `role:` names nobody.
- `messaging-service.test.ts`, describe "role: resolves in the emitting organization — the producer's, else the stored event row's": a producer naming no organization reaches the holders in the event row's organization only; neither names one: 0 recipients and no membership read; a producer-named organization is used as given (control). Also: an emit with no producer organization and a stamped event row resolves `org:members` to nobody while `role:` resolves in the stamped organization; control: a producer-named organization is used by `org:members` and `role:` alike.
- Fixture triage: two existing resolver cases and one emit case that used `role:` incidentally now pass an organization (the failing-query case also asserts its read is attempted).
- The new emit pins override the file's own `fakeData` engine double rather than adding a new one (`check:engine-double-contract` and `check:objectql-double-limit` green).

## Acceptance notes

- The service-automation consumer pin moved with the rule in this PR (surface widened by the seat): `notify-zero-delivery-visibility` + `notify-organization-stamp` 22/22 under the lock at `c8bc3f1372`.
- Follow-ups owed to the security#1 seat (filed): step 3b preference scoping; a real-engine pin of the event-row fallback; `resolveAudience`'s per-spec branch to pass a one-entry list.
- `emit()` step 3b's preference filter still reads with the producer's organization (`input.organizationId`), not the `owned` one. Not changed here (outside the stated rule); noted for the seat.
